title.zh: 半周长线长 HPWL：一个估计，以及它的边界
title.en: Half-perimeter wirelength: an estimate and its limits

note: Silent film with burned-in Chinese captions. Line durations come from scripts/build-clock.mjs (reading-time rule), never from measured speech.

07.en: A low score is not a good placement

lines.zh: 布局（placement）决定每个单元放在芯片上的哪个位置。
lines.en: Placement decides where each cell sits on the chip.

lines.zh: 单元之间由线网（net）相连。位置一变，连线的长短也会变。
lines.en: Cells are joined by nets. Move a cell and its connections get longer or shorter.

lines.zh: 真实的导线要到布线（routing）阶段才画出来，代价很高。
lines.en: Real wires are only drawn during routing, which is expensive.

lines.zh: 布局时需要一个又快、又能比较的线长估计：HPWL。
lines.en: During placement we need a fast, comparable wirelength estimate: HPWL.

lines.zh: 图中的细虚线只表示“谁和谁相连”，不是导线。
lines.en: The thin dashed lines only show who connects to whom. They are not wires.

lines.zh: 本课把引脚看成点。单位是抽象的网格单位，x 向右，y 向上。
lines.en: Pins are points. Units are abstract grid units; x grows right and y grows up.

lines.zh: 这是简化：真实单元有面积，引脚相对单元还有偏移。
lines.en: This is a simplification: real cells have area and pins sit at offsets.

lines.zh: P 在 (1, 2)，Q 在 (6, 2)。它们的包围盒宽 5、高 0。
lines.en: P is at (1, 2), Q at (6, 2). Their bounding box is 5 wide and 0 high.

lines.zh: HPWL = 宽 + 高 = 5 + 0 = 5。
lines.en: HPWL = width + height = 5 + 0 = 5.
New positions: P (1, 1), Q (5, 4). Four across, three up.

lines.zh: HPWL = 4 + 3 = 7。两引脚时它就是曼哈顿距离，不是直线距离 5。
lines.en: HPWL = 4 + 3 = 7. For two pins it is the Manhattan distance, not the straight-line 5.

lines.zh: 芯片导线大多沿水平、竖直方向走。图中的 L 形只是许多等长路径之一。
lines.en: Chip wires mostly run horizontally and vertically. The L shape is just one of many equal-length paths.

title.en: Scan the pins one by one

lines.zh: 四引脚线网 N1 = {P, Q, R, S}。逐个读取引脚，记下最小、最大的 x 和 y。
lines.en: Four-pin net N1 = {P, Q, R, S}. Read the pins one by one and keep the smallest and largest x and y.

lines.zh: P 给出初值；Q 刷新最大 x 和最大 y；R 再刷新最大 y；S 在内部，什么也没改。
lines.en: P sets the start; Q raises max x and max y; R raises max y again; S is inside and changes nothing.
Width = 7 − 1 = 6, height = 6 − 1 = 5, HPWL = 6 + 5 = 11.

lines.zh: 包围盒的周长是 2 ×（6 + 5）= 22，取一半正好是宽 + 高 = 11。
lines.en: The box perimeter is 2 × (6 + 5) = 22; half of it is width + height = 11.

lines.zh: 所以 HPWL 不是周长 22，不是两两距离之和 35，也不是一条真实导线的长度。
lines.en: So HPWL is not the perimeter 22, not the all-pairs sum 35, and not the length of a real wire.

lines.zh: 把极值引脚 Q 向右拖：最大 x 从 7 变成 9，宽 6 → 8，HPWL 11 → 13。
lines.en: Drag the extreme pin Q right: max x goes from 7 to 9, width 6 → 8, HPWL 11 → 13.

lines.zh: 再把 Q 往下拉到 y = 0：越过 y = 1 时，最小 y 从 P 换成 Q，高 5 → 6，HPWL = 14。
lines.en: Pull Q down to y = 0: past y = 1 the minimum y switches from P to Q, height 5 → 6, HPWL = 14.

lines.zh: 每一帧的数字都由同一组坐标当场重算，图形和算式不会错位。
lines.en: Every frame recomputes the numbers from the same coordinates, so the picture and the arithmetic stay in step.

lines.zh: 现在移动内部引脚 S。只要它留在其他引脚的包围盒（绿色区域）里，N1 一直是 14。
lines.en: Now move the interior pin S. While it stays inside the other pins' box (green), N1 stays 14.

lines.zh: 但 S 也在两引脚线网 N2 上：N2 从 4 变成 2，总和从 18 变成 16。
lines.en: But S is also on the two-pin net N2: N2 drops from 4 to 2 and the total from 18 to 16.

lines.zh: “选中的线网没变”不等于“总线长没变”。
lines.en: “The selected net did not change” is not “the total did not change”.

lines.zh: 老师的例子：六个单元 A–F，六个线网；ABCD 是一个四引脚线网，只算一个包围盒。
lines.en: The teacher's example: six cells A–F and six nets; ABCD is one four-pin net with one bounding box.

lines.zh: 逐网计算：AB、CD、AC、BD 各为 8，ABCD 为 16，EF 为 4。
lines.en: Net by net: AB, CD, AC and BD are 8 each, ABCD is 16, EF is 4.

lines.zh: ABCD 的最小 x 由 A 和 C 一起取到：它们是并列的极值引脚。
lines.en: ABCD's minimum x is reached by both A and C: they are tied extreme pins.

lines.zh: （自由点模式）把 A 右移 2：C 还在 x = 0，ABCD 仍是 16；AB 8 → 6，AC 8 → 10，总和仍是 52。
lines.en: (Free-point mode) Move A right by 2: C still holds x = 0, ABCD stays 16; AB 8 → 6, AC 8 → 10, total still 52.

lines.zh: 老师给的紧凑参考布局：同样的线网，总 HPWL = 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 4 + 2 = 14。
lines.en: The teacher's compact reference: same nets, total HPWL = 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 4 + 2 = 14.

lines.zh: 52 → 14 少了 38 个坐标单位。这是两个布局的比较，不是优化过程，也不是实测的走线节省。
lines.en: 52 → 14 is 38 coordinate units less. It compares two placements; it is not an optimization run or a measured routing saving.

lines.zh: 数据把 A、D 标为固定焊盘，紧凑布局却移动了它们：这只是自由点模式下的测量。
lines.en: The data marks A and D as fixed pads, yet the compact layout moves them: this is a free-point measurement only.

lines.zh: 可选扩展：给每个线网一个权重，例如 ABCD 的权重为 5，其余为 1。
lines.en: Optional: give each net a weight, e.g. ABCD weighs 5 and the others 1.

lines.zh: 加权和：起始 116，紧凑 30。权重改变的是目标，不改变 HPWL 的定义。
lines.en: Weighted sums: starter 116, compact 30. Weights change the objective, not the definition of HPWL.

lines.zh: 如果把六个点全部叠到同一个位置，每个包围盒都缩成一点，HPWL = 0。
lines.en: Stack all six points in one place and every box shrinks to a point: HPWL = 0.

lines.zh: 分数最低，却不是可用的布局：真实单元有面积，会互相重叠。
lines.en: The lowest score, yet not a usable placement: real cells have area and would overlap.

lines.zh: 给每个单元一个 1 × 1 的占位方块：15 对单元全部重叠。
lines.en: Give each cell a 1 × 1 footprint: all 15 pairs overlap.

lines.zh: 固定 A (0, 0) 和 D (8, 8)：ABCD 至少 16，AB + BD 与 AC + CD 也各至少 16。
lines.en: Fix A (0, 0) and D (8, 8): ABCD is at least 16, and AB + BD and AC + CD are each at least 16.

lines.zh: 点模型的下限是 48；再要求 1 × 1 方块互不重叠，EF ≥ 1，下限变成 49。
lines.en: The point-model bound is 48; with non-overlapping 1 × 1 footprints EF ≥ 1, so the bound becomes 49.

lines.zh: 比较 HPWL 之前，先确认约束是否成立。
lines.en: Before comparing HPWL, check that the constraints hold.

lines.zh: 第一步先检查输入：未知引脚、空线网、非有限坐标都要报错，不能悄悄算成 0。
lines.en: First validate: unknown pins, empty nets and non-finite coordinates raise errors instead of a silent 0.

lines.zh: 然后对每个线网：求最小、最大的 x 和 y，宽加高，累加到总和。
lines.en: Then for each net: find min and max x and y, add width plus height to the total.

lines.zh: 一次遍历所有引脚即可，代价与引脚总数成正比。
lines.en: One pass over all pins; the cost grows linearly with the number of pins.

lines.zh: HPWL = 宽 + 高，是包围盒周长的一半；多引脚线网只算一个包围盒。
lines.en: HPWL = width + height, half the box perimeter; a multi-pin net counts one box.

lines.zh: 移动极值引脚会改变盒子；内部移动不改变该线网，但可能改变别的线网。
lines.en: Moving an extreme pin changes the box; an interior move keeps that net but may change others.

lines.zh: 更低的 HPWL 不能单独证明布局合法或可用。下面的实验台可以从任意一帧接着操作。
lines.en: A lower HPWL alone does not prove a placement legal or usable. The lab below continues from any frame.
